            theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_generic_prime_image {k F A : Type u} {n : Type w} {X : Type u_4} [Field k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [Infinite X] [Fintype n] [DecidableEq n] (G : Set A) (hfin : G.Finite) (hG : Algebra.adjoin k G = ⊤) (ρ : X → A →ₐ[k] Matrix n n F) (hfull : ∀ (x : X), Submodule.span F (Set.range ⇑(ρ x)) = ⊤) :
            ∃ (S : Set X) (_ : S.Infinite) (K : Type (max u w)) (x : Field K) (q : A →+* Matrix n n K), Submodule.span K (Set.range ⇑q) = ⊤ ∧ (∀ (a b : A), q a ≠ 0 → q b ≠ 0 → ∃ (z : A), q (a * z * b) ≠ 0) ∧ ∀ (a b : A), q a = q b → ∀ x ∈ S, (ρ x) a = (ρ x) b

            An infinite family of full-span geometric representations of a finitely generated ground algebra has an infinite subfamily with a prime generic image. Every relation in that image holds throughout the subfamily.
